Write a randomisation list with SOP-compliant file names

write_rando_list.Rd

Writes each stratum to a CSV file named <study>_<dummy|final>_<MonYYYY>_R<version>[_<code>-<stratum>].csv (SOP 4.1.b) and a log file with the generation settings, MD5 sums and session information. It refuses to write a final list into a Biostatistics folder and checks that the arm names agree with the dummy flag.

Usage

write_rando_list(x, dir, study, dummy, date = Sys.Date(),
  forbidden_dirs = "BIOSTAT", overwrite = FALSE)

Arguments

x

Result of createRandoList.

dir

Existing output directory.

study

Study number or name.

dummy

The dummy flag: TRUE for the statistician's dummy list, FALSE for the pharmacist's final list.

date

Date used for the MonthYear in the file name.

forbidden_dirs

Regular expressions; a final list is not written to a directory whose path matches any of them (case-insensitive).

overwrite

Replace existing files?

Details

For a dummy list all arm names must contain "Dummy"; for a final list none may. The log contains the seed, so for the final list it must be stored with the final code in the secure Pharmacy folder.

Value

Invisibly, a data frame of written files and their MD5 sums.

Examples

x <- createRandoList(nPat = 20, arm_names = dummy_arm_names(c("Dex", "Pla"), TRUE),
                     seed = 1)
out <- write_rando_list(x, dir = tempdir(), study = "24XX", dummy = TRUE,
                        overwrite = TRUE)
basename(out$file)
#> [1] "24XX_dummy_Nov2026_R4.6.2.csv"     "24XX_dummy_Nov2026_R4.6.2_log.txt"
